Baseball Collection — Searchable Reference

Physical inventory + set ownership + historical evidence • Updated from Google Drive November 2, 2026

Collection — Import Existing Records

Import a CSV exported from your Baseball Master workbook. Your master file will not be edited. This reference is preloaded with the verified Google Drive workbook snapshot. You can import an updated CSV later.

Import a category at a time. Choose a category, then select its CSV file(s). Refresh merges matching record IDs within that category, adds new records, preserves other categories and all discoveries. For a full snapshot refresh, repeat for each category. No permanent workbook edits.

CSV headers recognized include Player, Team, Year, Set, Card Number, Variation, Binder, Page, Pocket, Quantity, Status and Record ID. Imports merge into the selected category without replacing other categories; saved discoveries are retained. Use a single inventory export with one row per physical record when possible. A checklist “Have” flag alone does not prove an extra physical copy.

Collection — Find a Card

Historical records and set Have selections are evidence, not extra physical cards. A missing search result means “not found in this imported reference,” not proof that you do not own the card.

New Card — Discovery Intake

Use this when a card is not found or needs an identity check. It stays in a separate review queue and is not automatically added to your permanent master.

Duplicate Comparison — Live Matches

Card Intake — Export to Master & Duplicate Tracker

Save discoveries above, then export a review file. These exports do not write to Google Drive or automatically add physical inventory. Review identities and variations before importing into your permanent master.

How to use — Quick Guide

The current Google Drive master snapshot is embedded. Refresh each category independently using its exported CSV; matching records are updated and new records are added. Back up before refreshing. Search each card before entering a discovery. Compare the year, set, number, and exact parallel: a base card and refractor are different versions. Record location and verification notes. Export your discoveries or JSON backup regularly. The preloaded reference works offline. New discoveries use local browser storage; opening it on another phone or browser will not transfer entries automatically.
